actions.label: Next page
actions.description: Advance to the next info page (DOWN button).

actions.label: Previous page
actions.description: Go back to the previous info page (UP button).

actions.label: Enter idle
actions.description: Turn off the backlight and enter low-power idle state.

actions.label: Enter info
actions.description: Return to the Info telemetry page carousel.

actions.label: Enter configuration
actions.description: Switch to Configuration mode (requires P7 countdown to complete).

actions.label: Save configuration
actions.description: Commit pending configuration changes to NVS and Modbus registers.

actions.label: Reset session counters
actions.description: Issues the Reset Session Modbus command for all ready sensors.

actions.label: Reset all measured totals
actions.description: Issues the Reset All Measured Modbus command.

actions.label: Factory reset
actions.description: Wipes NVS, clears Modbus config, and reboots after 30 s countdown.

actions.label: Save sensor settings
actions.description: Commit sensor sub-menu values after Nyquist validation.

actions.label: Begin field edit
actions.description: Put the focused configuration field into edit mode.

actions.label: Confirm field edit
actions.description: Accept the tentative value and write to Modbus register.

actions.label: Cancel field edit
actions.description: Discard tentative value and restore prior.

values.description: Remaining seconds on the active countdown
